# pmon_role_assignment (Resource)

A role granted straight to a principal, bypassing groups.

Prefer `pmon_group_roles`: a direct assignment is invisible in the group structure and is easy to lose track of when someone changes team. Reach for this only when an entitlement genuinely belongs to one person and no group describes it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Prefer pmon_group_roles. A direct assignment does not show up in the group structure and is
# easy to lose track of when someone changes team.
resource "pmon_role_assignment" "oncall" {
  principal = "alice@example.com"
  role_name = pmon_role.service_alpha.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal` (String) Principal to grant the role to.
- `role_name` (String) Role to grant.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Composite id: principal, then role name.
terraform import pmon_role_assignment.oncall 'alice@example.com,service:alpha'
```
